screenshots.title: Measurement takeoff
screenshots.alt: GridScalr showing a calibrated industrial floor plan with warehouse, office and workshop measurements and the Properties panel.
screenshots.description: A calibrated industrial takeoff with rectangle areas, counts, a deduction and drawing annotations.

screenshots.title: Measure and annotate
screenshots.alt: GridScalr with the Length tool active, the Layers panel open and the context bar showing the target layer, New measurement options and Canvas controls.
screenshots.description: Measurement and drawing tools share one canvas but stay on separate layer types.

screenshots.title: Markups and layers
screenshots.alt: GridScalr Layers panel with a revision cloud around a loading dock, a callout at the entrance and an inspected stamp.
screenshots.description: Revision clouds, callouts and status stamps live on drawing layers.

screenshots.title: Expanded layer items
screenshots.alt: GridScalr Layers panel with page-scoped layers, a measurement layer expanded to show items on the current page, and the Add/Deduct switch in the context bar.
screenshots.description: Expand a layer to inspect every item, select it on the plan and choose additive or deduction areas.

screenshots.title: Quantities
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Quantities dialog showing gross, deduction, net, waste and order quantities by category and room.
screenshots.description: Live quantities with deductions, waste and rounding for procurement.

screenshots.title: Measurements list
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Measurements dialog listing all three pages with search, page and type filters, and row actions.
screenshots.description: Find, select and navigate every measurement and drawing across all pages.

screenshots.title: Drawing export
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Drawing PDF export dialog with page range, crop area, layer selection, labels and legend options.
screenshots.description: Export visible markups as a flattened drawing PDF without modifying the source drawing.

screenshots.title: Workflows in the help dialog
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Help dialog open on the Workflows tab with guides for operations technicians and technical property managers.
screenshots.description: Task-oriented workflows sit beside the full user guide, shortcuts and About.
